description: Discover Memento workflows, resources, and execution guidance.
name: memory_help

description: Read service readiness, repository revision, and configured limits.
name: memory_status

description: Search visible concepts by lexical or semantic query.
name: memory_search

description: Read one visible concept by path or concept id.
name: memory_read

description: List visible concepts under a path prefix.
name: memory_list

description: Read a bounded namespace inventory with stable body digests and asset metadata, without concept bodies.
name: memory_inventory

description: Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.
name: memory_compare_manifest

description: Inspect bounded asset version metadata and concept-body parity without returning ZIPs or concept bodies.
name: memory_asset_metadata

description: Inspect graph neighbors and backlinks for a concept.
name: memory_graph

description: Audit authorised repository content and bounded graph diagnostics with deterministic repair guidance.
name: memory_audit

description: Create a deterministic proposal from explicit changes.
name: memory_propose

description: Read a bounded proposal summary or the detailed proposal record with per-change conflict metadata.
name: memory_proposal_get

description: List bounded, cursor-paginated summaries of visible proposal records.
name: memory_proposal_list

description: Inspect staged proposal asset metadata or one bounded manifest-listed file.
name: memory_proposal_asset_get

description: Rebase a clean proposal in place, retaining author and assets; original author or scoped curator, durable key required.
name: memory_proposal_rebase

description: Create a follow-up proposal from a conflict-free subset of a stale proposal.
name: memory_proposal_revise

description: Reconcile an owned operation; proposers may reconcile their own rebases, curators their own mutations.
name: memory_operation_get

description: Review a proposal as curator.
name: memory_proposal_review

description: Apply an approved proposal through the Git transaction pipeline.
name: memory_proposal_apply

description: Create a one-time raw ZIP upload ticket for a staged asset pack.
name: memory_asset_stage_begin

description: Reconcile a staged asset upload ticket and retrieve its staged_asset_id.
name: memory_asset_stage_status

description: Read an accepted asset: view=manifest omits ZIP bytes; view=file requires file_path; view=archive supports bounded offset/limit. Small archives remain inline by default. Resume with the resolved version and expected_sha256. Limits: memory_status.limits.assets.
name: memory_asset_get

description: Prune retained asset pack versions as curator.
name: memory_asset_prune

description: Create a concept directly as curator.
name: memory_create

description: Patch a concept directly as curator.
name: memory_patch

description: Move a concept to /trash/ retaining original permissions and assets.
name: memory_trash

description: Restore a trashed concept to its original path; reject collisions.
name: memory_restore

description: Permanently delete a trashed concept and accepted assets from current state; requires confirm=true and retains Git history.
name: memory_purge

description: Rename a concept directly as curator.
name: memory_rename
